name: print-social-infographic-retro-teal-cream-device-stack
title: Retro teal/cream infographic with stacked device illustrations
whatItIs: A vertically stacked infographic in muted teal and cream, using flat retro-style monitor/laptop/phone illustrations, a donut chart, gender icon comparison bars and a bottom row of small social icons.
whatItMeans: A muted retro palette and rounded flat device illustrations soften a data-heavy layout, making device-usage statistics feel more editorial than a typical dashboard export.
techniques: stack devices by size (monitor, laptop, phone) to visually represent a usage hierarchy
use dashed leader lines from a donut chart to labeled percentages
bookend the layout with a banner header and icon-row footer for clear start/end points

vocabulary.definition: a pie chart variant with a hollow center, often used to display proportional data
